spots.name: Spy Rock
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 533 m (1,749 ft).

spots.name: Lookout
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing southeast. Good for sunrise. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Inspiration Point
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing south. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Hayden Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.
